news.name: Possible Thunderfury-Themed Cloak on Season of Discovery PTR
news.pinDescription: There might be a fun bonus Thunderfury-themed item in store for players in Season of Discovery based on the Patch 1.15.4 PTR!

news.name: Thunderfury Model Size Adjusted on Classic Realms
news.pinDescription: With the launch of Season of Discovery Patch 1.15.3, eagle-eyed players have noticed a change to Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker - it's gotten significantly smaller.

news.name: Thunderfury Will Not Be Changing in Season of Discovery Phase 4
news.pinDescription: As we prepare for Phase 4 Season of Discovery, it has felt like every item has had some huge changes. So some players were relieved too learn that [item=19019] will not be changed.

news.name: WoW Classic Not A Bug List - Thunderfury Can be Equipped by All Sword Classes
news.pinDescription: Blizzard has updated their "not a bug" list for WoW Classic with a clarification concerning the legendary sword [item=19019].

news.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker Available with WoW Classic Blackwing Lair Phase 3
news.pinDescription: Did someone say [item=19019]? While players have been able to collect the bindings since WoW Classic launch, [item=19019] will finally be obtainable in Phase 3 of WoW Classic when Blackwing Lair opens.

news.name: More NA and EU Classic Realms - Thunderfury, Benediction, Windseeker
news.pinDescription: Did someone say [item=19019]? Well you'll be right at home on the new servers Thunderfury and Windseeker. Six more Classic realms have been added this afternoon.

news.name: Classic WoW Phase Loot Clarifications and Confusion - Thunderfury Bindings Available at Launch
news.pinDescription: Blizzard has been clarifying how some phase loot works in Classic WoW. While some parts remain unclear, as to preserve an element of exploration, other parts have received more clarifications. For example, Thunderfury Bindings will be available at launch.
